methods.name: public void attach()
methods.comment:
* Attach the helper to the view. *

* This will replace previously existing touch and long click listeners.

methods.name: public void detach()
methods.comment:
* Detach the helper from the view. *

* This will reset touch and long click listeners to {@code null}.

methods.name: public boolean onTouch(@NonNull View v, @NonNull MotionEvent event)
methods.comment:
* Handle a touch event.
     * @param v The view the touch event has been dispatched to.
     * @param event The MotionEvent object containing full information about
     *        the event.
     * @return True if the listener has consumed the event, false otherwise.

methods.name: public boolean onLongClick(@NonNull View v)
methods.comment:
* Handle a long click event.
     * @param v The view that was clicked and held.
     * @return true if the callback consumed the long click, false otherwise.

methods.name: public void getTouchPosition(@NonNull Point point)
methods.comment:
* Compute the position of the touch event that started the drag operation.
     * @param point The position of the touch event that started the drag operation.

methodNames: public boolean onTouch(@NonNull View v, @NonNull MotionEvent event)
